output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Build 7.4.0 users crash at about 2% whether or not the flag is on, and that was already true on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp. The flag-on versus random flag-off holdout difference within 7.4.0 is only +0.12 points, and the interval runs from -0.08 to +0.32. The flag could still add a few tenths of a point, so that remains unresolved. The flag is only available on 7.4.0, so the raw comparison of flagged users against everyone else was really 7.4.0 against 7.3.2. Device mix and usage are matched across groups, the sync-service deploy did not move the 7.3.2 rate, and the app-store console confirms the crash rates independently of the crash-reporting SDK. The leading crash cluster is a new Pixelda HEIF decode crash, first seen 2 Sep. It makes up 41% of crash events in 7.4.0 and does not occur in 7.3.2. Do not turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to 100%, because that would ship the real crash source to everyone. Instead, hold the rollout at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash, and add the screen that requested the decode to the crash reports. Keep the existing holdout running to measure any flag effect. Don't roll back the crash-reporting SDK. Confidence is fairly high.
